rows.title: Mapped capabilities are regulated
rows.defect: the map is read by the wrong field, so everything is unregulated
rows.test: ACH push is regulated and blocked; account read is not

rows.title: Advice is never
rows.defect: advice gets an RIA partner key, so a live record unblocks it
rows.test: no live partner record unblocks investment advice

rows.title: Unspecified is execution
rows.defect: any falsy executes counts as staging

rows.title: Staging needs no partner
rows.test: a staged send is allowed, the person acts

rows.title: A partner unblocks its own requirement
rows.defect: any live partner stands in for the missing one
rows.test: a live broker-dealer does not unblock ACH

rows.title: No KYC record fails closed
rows.defect: a missing KYC record counts as verified (the bug this packet found)
rows.test: a live money partner and no KYC record blocks

rows.title: KYC moves on valid events only
rows.defect: a cleared event skips the partner's check

rows.title: Identity details in the partner's form
rows.defect: the details are asked for in chat
rows.test: needs_info says hosted form, never stored by Upmore

rows.title: The blocked send names the app
rows.defect: the capability's full name is said

rows.title: Information-only still needs the partner to execute
rows.defect: an information-only capability is allowed even when it executes
rows.test: binding insurance and filing taxes are blocked

rows.title: Disclosures once per version
rows.defect: any earlier disclosure silences a new version
rows.test: an older version is said again

rows.title: A playbook stops at a failed step
rows.defect: the playbook runs on after a failure
rows.test: nothing after the failed step runs

rows.title: The report says live only when it is
rows.defect: any truthy flag is reported live (the bug this packet found)

rows.title: Unbuilt claims are findings
rows.defect: a gated or claimed capability counts as backed
rows.test: 'I can pay a bill' is a finding
